thread:
Elaine (Docs): Quick heads-up — opened PR with consolidated 429 + timeout UX examples and a few new SDK snippets. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 (pls review). Need examples for: short retry window, context-trim fallback, and user-facing copy for 429/timeouts.
Kevin (SDK): On it. I'll add a Python snippet showing `backoff` header usage and the new retry header parsing. Where in the repo should I drop examples? `docs/snippets/sdk/python/rate_limit.md` ?
Vikram (eng-runtime): FYI runtime team emits a couple of subtly different 429s depending on batching — would be helpful to call out "burst 429" vs "steady-state 429" and what callers should do. Suggest a tiny diagram or short bullet table.
Sam (QA): I can produce reproducible harness logs for the "context-limit then timeout" flow. I'll push sample `curl` commands and a minimal repro script.
Lina (Product): Also include an explicit note about UX: don't surface raw 429 JSON to end users. Recommended short copy: "We're temporarily throttling requests. Please try again in a few seconds."
Kevin (SDK): Adding a snippet now. Example:
```python
# handle 429 with Retry-After and X-Redwood-Retry-Window
resp = client.generate(...)
if resp.status_code == 429:
    wait = int(resp.headers.get("Retry-After") or resp.headers.get("X-Redwood-Retry-Window", 1))
    # backoff logic: small jitter
```
Elaine (Docs): Nice. Can you also include a Node/TS variant? We need both languages in the SDK docs.
Kevin (SDK): Yup. I'll PR a small code block for node as well and mirror the examples folder structure.
Vikram (eng-runtime): One more ops note — add a short paragraph about fallback policy ordering: prefer shorter/quantized model variants in the same pool, then region fallback, then rate-limit-backoff. That helps folks design graceful degradation.
Sam (QA): Where should I put the harness logs? Thinking `docs/err-ref/examples/429-timeouts/harness-logs.md`. Will include raw console output (sanitized), commands, and a tiny replay script.
Elaine (Docs): Yes, that path works. I'll update the PR description with file mapping and a checklist: snippets, logs, UX copy, fallback paragraph. Tagging @Kevin, @Vikram for review. @docs-bot can you add the `docs/err-ref` label?
docs-bot: Label added: docs/err-ref
Elaine (Docs): Last ask — can someone sanity-check the suggested end-user copy? @Lina?
Lina (Product): Looks good. Maybe trim to: "Try again in a few seconds." Done.
Kevin (SDK): PR updated with Python + Node snippets and the path suggestions. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482/files
Vikram (eng-runtime): Left a quick review comment on the fallback ordering wording — minor tweak.
Elaine (Docs): Thanks all — I'll merge after one more SDK approval. If anyone wants to pair on the Node snippet or the small diagram, ping me tomorrow.
